title: Controlled CAMA Replication on Amazon item-ltv: 10-Epoch Resolution of Instability
summary: Demo notebook analyzing pre-computed results from a controlled 2-method x 5-seed experiment comparing CAMA (Cardinality-Aware Moment Aggregation) vs mean-aggregation baseline on rel-amazon/item-ltv. Demonstrates the CAMA module with a synthetic-data unit test (verifying shape, gradients, gate initialization at 0.5), then reproduces statistical analysis (Cohen's d=13.58, bootstrap CI, t-test, Wilcoxon) on loaded results. Visualizes learning curves across seeds, CAMA gate evolution showing divergence from 0.5 initialization on review-to-product edges, cross-iteration comparison bar chart, and per-seed MAE comparison. Data: curated subset with 3 seeds' learning curves (10 epochs each), gate snapshots at epochs 1/5/10, and summary statistics for all 5 seeds.
